payload.content: It depends which jaguar you mean. The animal (Panthera onca) can sprint at roughly 80 km/h (about 50 mph) over short distances, though it is an ambush hunter and rarely runs far. For Jaguar cars, the F-Type R 75 is limited to 186 mph, and the historic XJ220 reached 212.3 mph, the fastest Jaguar production car.
